entries.name: Human
entries.description: The registered living of the Warrens. Adaptable: +25% XP, +1 starting attribute point, and bonus talent points at levels 3 and 6.

entries.name: Revenant
entries.description: One of the catalogued dead who refused the record. Hard to kill twice, slow to mend: healing works at half strength. Resists Cold (+50%) and Void (+25%), vulnerable to Radiant (-25%).

entries.name: Cambion
entries.description: Born of a contract signed beneath the Geometry. Their blows find the gaps in any armor. Resists Fire (+50%) and Void (+25%), vulnerable to Cold (-25%).
